g.text: • TEMP, MOT, VIT, ECG push SensorMessage
• Cadence: 1000 ms audit (6000 ms silence limit)
OLED shows SYSTEM DEGRADED banner; TWDT panic if hung
2. Rapid 3.3 Hz Red LED Blink + Buzzer Tone
4. Held at 80 mg/hr until button pressed or lowered
• Slew Rate Limiter: Max step +5.0 mg/hr/sec
• Actuator: SG90 Servo on GPIO 18 (PWM 500-2400 μs)
If Pending: Req / Now / PRESS BUTTON
Dual-zone layout: Offline/health alert never clobbers dose UI
• DEGRADED: Transport OK, Task Heartbeat stall
• OFFLINE: Wi-Fi lost or MQTT disconnected
OFFLINE triggers buzzer failure tones & local buffer
0-100 ms ON, 200-300 ms ON per 1000 ms
• MQTT Broker Drop: Slow Single Beep
0-500 ms ON, 500-1000 ms OFF per 1000 ms
• Policy: Drops newest entries when saturated
• On Connect: mqttTask drains offlineBuffer FIFO
• Rate-Limited: Paced to obey Adafruit IO quotas
CLI test: SIM_ONLINE flushes buffer to cloud
